Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick call earlier. We're reviewing the redline you sent and have a few specifics to confirm before procurement moves the DPA to legal review:

- Can Redwood confirm which version of the EU SCCs you intend to incorporate by reference in the DPA? We need the exact module/appendix text and whether the document will include the UK IDTA / UK addendum as an incorporated schedule.
- For the TIA/DTIA evidence, procurement needs a high-level sequence: what artifacts will Redwood provide (keys: TLS/certificate rotation, data residency map, TIA report) and an expected delivery cadence during onboarding?
- Subprocessor list: we received an earlier snapshot but need the latest active subprocessors that will process EU/UK patient data and whether any of them use on-prem proxies or cloud-edge caching in APAC/US regions.

Hi Ari — thanks for the list, and great to meet you on the call. Short answers up front then a proposed deliverable plan below.

- SCCs/version: Redwood will adopt the 2024 EU SCCs (module 2/processor-controller where applicable). We will include the UK IDTA as a signed addendum when Stella executes the DPA; we can supply the exact text of the incorporation clause and the UK addendum PDF in the signing packet.

- TIA/DTIA artifacts & cadence (proposed):
  1) Pre-sign: high-level TIA summary (1–2 pages) + subprocessor inventory snapshot (CSV) — within 48 hours of countersign acceptance.
  2) Day 0/onboarding: full TIA/DTIA artifact package (redacted findings, mitigation summary, network diagram) + signed UK addendum (if applicable).
  3) Post-onboard (30 days): operational evidence (KV cache locations, onshore fallback config, rotation logs sample).

- Subprocessors: latest active list attached (CSV). We note two processors that operate edge cache nodes in APAC; neither stores full raw payloads — they operate ephemeral prefix caches. I'll flag these in the mapping.

Attachments: redwood-DPA-v3_redlined.pdf, SCCs-UK-addendum-mapping.csv (stubs)

Proposed next step: I can send a DocuSign packet that incorporates the 2024 SCCs and the UK IDTA as an addendum for Stella to review. If procurement is comfortable, we can also provide a mutual action plan (MAP) with the evidence delivery milestones.

If that's acceptable I'll loop in Michael (policy) and Marissa (onboarding ops) to confirm timelines.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Legal Operations
Redwood Inference

Callouts for APAC-edge behavior should be explanatory (non-contractual) — describe ephemeral caching and TTLs; do not change the SCC text. - Ops timelines: Marissa, can you confirm, but we have the instrumentation to extract a redacted KMS rotation log and a network diagram. Day 0 package within 3 business days is feasible assuming countersign is received; the 30-day operational artifacts are standard.
